title.zh: 播报单热点自定义摘要生成
title.en: Generate custom summary for hot spot broadcast list

descriptions.zh:
通过此接口，可以流式生成播报单热点下自定义风格的热点摘要。

欢迎前往[控制台](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/#/app/app-market/quanmiao/news-broadcast)体验。

通过SDK方式调用API可参考控制台“API”下的示例。
descriptions.en:
This API enables stream-generation of a hot spot summary in a custom style for a single hot spot announcement.  

You can try it out in the [console](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/#/app/app-market/quanmiao/news-broadcast).  

For invoking the API via the software development kit (SDK), refer to the Sample under “API” in the console.
